notes.title: Be part of the game and win prizes!
notes.content:
There are two competitions running through Next Fest:

[h1]Create a level[/h1]
Create a level in the level editor and come and share it on our discord server and we will select the best and have them part of the final release of the game!

[h1]Top the leaderboard[/h1]
Finish 1st on any level by the end of Next Fest and win two copies of the game for you and a friend!
